test_mobile_cpu_transmuter: test the mobile CPU model transmuter by running TestModelTransmuter to verify Conv3d blocks are replaced with EfficientBlockBase
run_transmute_model: run transmute_model on a PyTorch nn.Module with target_device set to mobile_cpu to replace layers with efficient blocks
run_convert_to_deployable_form: run convert_to_deployable_form on a transmutated model and input tensor to produce a deployable model for mobile CPU inference
review_EfficientBlockBase: review the EfficientBlockBase class to understand which transmutated model layers inherit from it after mobile CPU conversion
refactor_residual_block: refactor a residual block model with Conv3d and ReLU layers to be compatible with the mobile CPU transmuter pipeline
